title: clematis integrifolia var. normalis
intro: Clematis integrifolia var. normalis, commonly known as Western pasque flower, is a plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Western pasque flower are attributed to its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which may aid in relaxing the nervous system and relieving muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Clematis integrifolia var. normalis include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, although more research is needed to confirm their specific roles and effects on human health.
